2608.24500.title: Scalable and Versatile Identification for Hierarchical Structural Causal Models: A New Look at Project STAR
2608.24500.paper_summary: The STAR (Student-Teacher Achievement Ratio) experiment (1985, Tennessee, USA) is a landmark hierarchical dataset designed to assess the impact of class size on student outcomes, with observations nested within classes. To encode class-level interventions in such hierarchical settings, we develop a complete, scalable, open-source pipeline for Hierarchical Structural Causal Models (HSCM) that bridges symbolic identification and practical estimation. Our approach integrates graph transformations, pyAgrum's do-calculus for automatic identification of causal effects, adaptation of symbolic expression into closed-form HSCM formulas, and numerical estimation from fitted local probability models. A key innovation is our adapted Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), which decomposes pyAgrum's identified formulas into independent density, expectation, and marginalization tasks, enabling parallel and scalable computation. We validate the pipeline on canonical HSCM motifs and benchmark scenarios with known ground truth, then apply it to STAR kindergarten mathematics outcomes. The results show that flat baselines (ignoring hierarchy) recover associations but fail to encode class-level interventions, and that symbolic identification alone is not enough for practical Hierarchical Structural Causal inference; scalable estimation and numerical stability checks are central parts of the scientific object.
2608.24500.paper_summary_zh: STAR（學生-教師成就比率）實驗（1985年，美國田納西州）是一個具有里程碑意義的層級數據集，旨在評估班級規模對學生成果的影響，觀察結果嵌套在班級中。<lb/>為了在這種層級環境中編碼班級層級的干預措施，我們開發了一個完整的、可擴展的、開源的層級結構因果模型（HSCM）管道，該管道橋接了符號識別和實際估計。<lb/>我們的方法整合了圖形轉換、pyAgrum的do-calculus進行因果效應的自動識別、將符號表達式轉換為封閉形式的HSCM公式，以及從擬合的局部概率模型中進行數值估計。<lb/>一個關鍵創新是我們改編的抽象語法樹（AST），它將pyAgrum識別的公式分解為獨立的密度、期望和邊際化任務，使得並行和可擴展計算成為可能。<lb/>我們在典型的HSCM圖案和已知真實情況的基準場景上驗證了該管道，然後將其應用於STAR幼兒園數學成果。<lb/>結果顯示，平坦基準（忽略層級）恢復了關聯，但未能編碼班級層級的干預措施，並且僅依賴符號識別不足以進行實際的層級結構因果推斷；可擴展的估計和數值穩定性檢查是科學對象的核心部分。
